title: Civic projects in Bengaluru
intro: I make maps and small tools to help explore everyday questions: getting across Bengaluru, finding help, or finding a word.

projects.name: Relief Riders
projects.label: Community mapping
projects.text: During the 2020 lockdown, Chintan Sheth and I helped map Relief Riders volunteers and areas where older residents might need help with groceries and medicine.

media.alt: A 2020 map of Relief Riders volunteers across Bengaluru wards.
media.label: Map of volunteers · Chintan Sheth and Pavan

projects.name: Magga
projects.label: BMTC spider maps
projects.text: I made spider maps of Bengaluru’s bus routes. Magga builds on LOOM to filter bus data and draw geographic and schematic maps with Indic labels.
projects.attribution: Built on LOOM by Hannah Bast, Patrick Brosi and Sabine Storandt.

media.alt: Labeled BMTC route junction at BEL Circle, with the route bundle continuing to Gokula.
media.label: BMTC spider-map detail around BEL Circle and Gokula

projects.name: Yeshtothu
projects.label: How long will the journey take?
projects.text: I built Yeshtothu to explore journey times in Bengaluru, including the wait. It uses observed BMTC bus journeys and published Metro timetables, so you can compare departure times and see how much a trip varies from day to day. Connections are modelled rather than observed end to end.
projects.attribution: Transit data: BengaWalk and Vonter. Map: © CARTO, © OpenStreetMap contributors.

media.alt: Yeshtothu shows a Hebbala Bridge to Tin Factory journey, with waiting and riding time, a daily variation chart and the route on a Bengaluru map.
media.label: Comparing the wait, the ride and the time of day for a journey across Bengaluru.
media.credit: Pavan / Yeshtothu · Transit data: BengaWalk and Vonter · Map: © CARTO, © OpenStreetMap contributors

projects.name: Rala
projects.label: A Kannada reverse dictionary
projects.text: I built Rala to find Kannada words from an English meaning. It brings together Alar by V. Krishna and the Government of Karnataka’s Padakanaja dictionaries.

media.alt: Rala showing the English query curiosity and matching Kannada words.
media.label: Kannada words for curiosity
media.credit: Pavan / Rala; dictionary sources Alar and Padakanaja

context: I also made BMTC spider maps to examine Bengaluru’s bus network. The Magga tools and sample maps are in the open-tools section.
